extracted text: The document studies a high-pressure die-cast (HPDC) AlSi9Cu3(Fe) alloy, which is identified as EN AB-46000, equivalent to the US designation A380. The die-castings were stored at room temperature for about 5 months before being analyzed and were similar to a T1-condition. The density of fully dense material is assumed to be 2.770 g/cm³. Tensile specimens with different gage diameters (6.0, 3.4, and 3.0 mm) were tested to study the effects of microstructural variations on mechanical properties.

Hardness: Vickers microhardness with a mean value of about 110 HV
